The issuer shows moderate liquidity (current ratio 1.34) and a reasonable operating profitability profile (EBIT of 2,494M on 18,044M revenue, ~14% EBIT margin). However, leverage is fairly high with total liabilities of 34,289M exceeding shareholders’ equity of 31,211M, which limits balance-sheet resilience. Overall, this points to a lower investment-grade profile.

DECISION: BBB-
